decisions.reason: Downgraded from its own page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 signals weak market results, making the option unlikely to pay off and worth abandoning.
Its continued but low-profile mention suggests the firm is keeping this low-cost option open while its decorative niche demand remains uncertain.
Sustained presentation on its own page indicates positive demand signals and reduced uncertainty, justifying continued commitment.
Mention-only status suggests marginal performance, but the product is cheap to keep while the market for higher-quality wool-blend decoration fabric remains uncertain.
Like other mention-only items, its very niche leno/bouclé combination keeps uncertainty high, so the firm retains the option at low cost.
Launched only in 2024 and given its own page, this newest option still has high uncertainty and visible initial investment, so it is kept.
